compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: At the seventh seal, silence gives way to an angel offering incense with prayers on the golden altar before God, then altar fire is thrown to earth.
observations.label: Incense rises with the prayers of the saints

observations.body: The passage presents silence, angel, golden altar, incense, prayers, rising smoke, fire, and earth as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: silence, angel, golden altar, incense, prayers, rising smoke, fire, and earth

observations.body: The passage places incense and prayer beside silence, angel, golden altar, incense, prayers, rising smoke, fire, and earth.
observations.label: incense and prayer

payload.posture: Read Revelation 8:1–5 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the prayers accompany incense but are not described as identical to it
